title: Towards Comprehensive Scene Understanding: Integrating First and Third-Person Views for LVLMs

layout.note: One dashed rounded frame split by a dashed vertical line into two scenario panels; each has an isometric scene at the left and a column of three question bubbles with a person icon and three answer bubbles with a robot icon at the right, a two-swatch legend underneath and the letter and title below the frame.

lesson: Motivate a task with a scene illustration on which translucent coloured overlays show what each viewpoint can see, next to a short question and answer column between a user icon and a robot icon; repeat the layout in a second domain to show the problem is general.
